## About

ML / AI engineering student at Universitas Teknologi Yogyakarta. I learn by building smaller versions of the things I read about, then breaking them until they work.

I care about what happens after training: datasets that don't need babysitting, APIs that behave, and pipelines that run the same on my laptop and on the server.

Deep in LLM apps, agent workflows, and computer vision — mostly late at night, with way too many print statements.

**Where I'm investing time:**

- **Machine Learning** — training models, tuning them, and getting inference fast enough to feel instant.
- **Artificial Intelligence** — LLM apps, agentic workflows, and retrieval that answers before you finish typing.
- **Software Engineering** — APIs, databases, and pipelines that keep AI a product instead of a prototype.

## Featured Work

- **[AI Image Processor](https://github.com/WaldiBahyHanif/ai-image-processor)** — _Computer Vision_. Deep-learning segmentation and processing pipeline for visual assets, engineered to survive real-world batch jobs.
- **[Agentic Chatbot](https://github.com/WaldiBahyHanif/agentic-chatbot)** — _Natural Language Processing_. Chat agent with tool execution that automates real tasks instead of just talking about them.
